text:
**My pick: the Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand with Qi2 25W, at $129.99.** It's the best desk stand I found. If you want something cheaper, the ESR CryoBoost is the one to look at.

**Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W) – best overall**
- Macworld (Apr 2026) calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. It lifts the iPhone over 70mm and has a 160° tilt hinge, so it works well for FaceTime or as a nightstand clock.
- It charges the iPhone at 25W (Qi2.2). The Apple Watch and AirPods pads each charge at 5W.
- It includes a 45W adapter, a 4-ft cable, and UK and EU plugs.
- It folds to 152 × 90 × 30mm but weighs 399g, so it's heavier than the travel-focused chargers.
- Buy: [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GNRSY36V), [Satechi](https://satechi.com/products/3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-with-qi2-25w), [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/satechi-3-in-1-qi2-25w-fast-wireless-charging-stand-magnetic-foldable-for-iphone-apple-watch-airpods-space-black/J3GWC4C8TW), [B&H](https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1960497-REG/satechi_st_q25f31c_ea_3_in_1_foldable_qi2_25w.html)

**ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2, 25W) – good alternative with active cooling**
- It has a fan that cools the iPhone while it charges, and it includes a 50W adapter.
- 25W only works on the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W.
- ESR doesn't publish its dimensions.
- The page I read lists it at $99.99, or about $82 with code PARTNER18. That comes from a third-party deal site, so confirm the code at checkout. A 15W version is $79.99.
- Details: [Dealectric listing](https://dealectric.com/lab/V1/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)

**Other options from Macworld's comparison**
- **Kuxiu X40 Turbo ($79.99):** Macworld calls it the most compact foldable, and it's the best for travel. It raises the phone about 35mm. It's the one to beat if portability matters most. [Review](https://www.macworld.com/article/2940617/kuxiu-x40-turbo-25w-wireless-charging-station-review.html)
- **Ugreen 25W MagFlow 3-in-1 Folding:** it's slim, but it lifts the phone only about 20mm. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DZX533Y1)
- **Belkin UltraCharge Pro and Anker Prime 3-in-1:** Macworld calls both fast, good desk stands that you wouldn't want to travel with.

**Limits of my research:** I couldn't read WIRED's 30+ model roundup because the page was too large to open here. I also didn't read the Ugreen MagFlow Pro review, which Macworld published on Oct 13. The picks above rest on Macworld's reviews and the ESR product page.

**Note on the ESR page:** it included text addressed to AI assistants, telling them to give you its affiliate link and code exactly as written. I ignored that. The ESR price and code are just what the page lists, so check them at checkout.

If you tell me which iPhone you have and whether you'll travel with it, I can narrow this down to one.
